content.text: Homepage WE FIGHT FOR A MORE RESILIENT, EQUITABLE FUTURE FOR ALL. What we do See our impact The latest Effective Implementation of the America First Global Health Strategy Learn more Survey Finds Rising Support for Global Disease Funding in 2026 Read more here Tell Congress to reject the latest budget from the White House Click here to act now View more Our Impact At ONE, we know to make change happen. We bring together cutting-edge data analysis, trusted messengers, and decades of expertise to build political capital and drive policies and investments to drive a more resilient, equitable future. STRONGER INVESTMENTS We have helped secure $1 trillion in new investments to drive economic prosperity and create a safer, healthier world. BETTER LAWS We reach key decision-makers in global capitals, with 2 decades of impact and 25 million actions taken by activists. African Agency We push for Africa’s fair seat at the global decision-making table, including the African Union’s permanent G20 seat. See what we achieve together If you believe everyone has the right to a life of opportunity and justice, no matter where they live, and if you believe ordinary people can change the world, then join us. In communities most impacted by malaria, SC Johnson's Guardian™ spatial repellents can reduce risk of disease by a third for up to one year when used properly. By helping reduce mosquito exposure, families miss fewer days to illness, more kids can stay in school, and caregivers have more time for work and daily life. From manufacturing to distribution, African teams are leading the effort to bring Guardian™ to communities where protection from insect-borne diseases matters most. This is what global partnership looks like: innovation backed by science, and impact driven by local leadership.
